## Before review

- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] An entry under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md` if the change reaches users, ending with what it reaches: `leglas`, `leglas-mcp` or the plugin
- [ ] `pnpm api:update` run and `api-surface.txt` committed, if what the packages export changed
- [ ] A screenshot, before and after where it helps, if the interface changed
